description: Get one audiovisual record by id: full description and transcription (where one exists), creator/publishing channel, duration, medium, subjects, places, language, rights, source, and three distinct links: `url` (the IWAC page, the one to cite), `external_url` (where a harvested video plays) and `media_url` (a deposited file). `source_type` says which to expect. A long transcription comes in 25k-char parts (follow `next_offset`); `keyword` returns excerpts instead.

offset.description: Read from this character on: the previous part's next_offset
